name: T2 Standard Task
description: Standard T2 task pipeline: requirements → design → implement → verify → writeback

plan_req.description: Fill task-spec.md §1 requirements and §2 R-ID acceptance entries

gate_req.wait_message: Review: task-spec.md §2 should have at least one R-ID defined. Verify and continue.

plan_design.description: Fill task-spec.md §3 design, §4 change list, §5 spec refs, §6 task checklist

edges.description: High-risk tasks need explicit design approval
Low-risk tasks proceed directly to implementation

gate_design.wait_message: High-risk task: review design in task-spec.md §3-§6 before proceeding to implementation.

implement.description: Implement changes per task-spec.md §6 checklist. Log changes in ledger.md §1.

verify.description: Run tests, fill ledger.md §4 verification results per R-ID

gate_accept.wait_message: Verify: all tests must pass and all R-IDs must have verification entries in ledger.md §4.

spec_writeback.description: Write back learnings to spec/domain/ and update knowledge.md if applicable

done.summary: Task completed. All R-IDs verified and specs updated.
